title: Spicy Thai Chicken Satay
description: A classic Asian-inspired dish featuring marinated chicken skewers grilled to perfection. Serve with peanut sauce and steamed vegetables for a flavorful and nutritious meal.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together peanut sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and chili peppers.
2. Add the chicken to the marinade and mix until coated.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
5. Thread marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
7. Serve skewers hot with peanut sauce for dipping.
8. Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
9. Serve with steamed vegetables and a side of peanut sauce for a complete meal.
